title: docs(skills): guard nullable validation operands, teach hook `body`, list `mailbox` / `package-registry`, drop `os generate agent`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xAX4MMULyw2ed8nbbZASMh9)_

Fixes #31113

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `skills/**` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling); it is waived by the standing order of the maintainer in this project (2026-11-03), and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 的 `rules/validation.md` 六处比较/算术谓词全部加 `!= null` 守卫，并写明未守卫的可空字段在发布时被拒；两个钩子示例（`validation.md`、`examples-objects.md`）改写为沙箱 `body`，`SKILL.md` 索引只把 `handler` 称为已弃用；`objectstack-platform` 的 `requires:` 表补 `mailbox`、`package-registry`；`operations.md` 的 `os generate` 行去掉已退役的 `agent`。
- 为什么改：这四处把发布门会拒绝、或已退役/已弃用的写法教给 AI（#31113）：裸可空比较被 `validate-null-guards` 拒绝；`handler` 已弃用；两个 token 在 `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` 里却不在表里；`agent` 在 `RETIRED_GENERATORS` 里。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字与 eval；五个文件全部在 token 上限内，无上限上调（增长全部用同文件删除支付，见下文）；发 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md` 的 External / Custom Validation 一节（席位裁定 A：`body` 无外呼 HTTP，外部 API 校验走 Connector recipe）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期退出 0，`57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 属 Tier H（人合），需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 的一次 approval，之后席位落地。

## What changes

### 1. Nullable operands in `rules/validation.md` are guarded

Code site: `packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts` (L29–L43: an ordering or arithmetic operator on a declared field with no `required: true` / `defaultValue` is rejected unless a `!= null` / `== null` / `isBlank()` test dominates it), wired into `validateStackExpressions` for `validations[].condition` / `.when` / `.then` / `.otherwise` (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` L44), which `os build`, `os validate`, `os lint` and the runtime publish gate run. `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` L112–L122 teaches the same rule.

The card named three sites; the file held six. The new sentence under § Expression Syntax states the rule, so the other three would have contradicted it on the same page; all six are guarded:

| Line | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| L60 script | `record.due_date < today()` | `record.due_date != null && record.due_date < today()` |
| L72 pattern | `record.amount < 0` | `record.amount != null && record.amount < 0` |
| L78 pattern | `record.end_date < record.start_date` | `record.start_date != null && record.end_date != null && record.end_date < record.start_date` |
| L159 cross_field | `record.end_date <= record.start_date` | same guards, `<=` |
| L166 cross_field | `record.discount_amount > record.subtotal * 0.5` | `record.discount_amount != null && record.subtotal != null && …` |
| L226 conditional `when` | `record.order_total > 10000` | `record.order_total != null && record.order_total > 10000` |

Measured, not assumed: `findUnguardedNullableOperands` (the gate's decision procedure, run through `tsx` with each field nullable) returns 1 or 2 findings for every "before" predicate and 0 for every "after" predicate.

§ Expression Syntax gains two lines (the line before them is byte-identical): "An ordering or arithmetic operator on a field with no `required: true` / `defaultValue` is refused at publish unless a `!= null` test guards it."

`<!-- os:check -->`: that gate (`packages/spec/scripts/check-skill-examples.ts`) is a `tsc` type-check, not the null-guard lint. A trial run marked all four candidate blocks: the § Script Validation block (L52) and the rewritten hook block (L250) type-check and keep their markers; the § Common Script Patterns block (`condition: …` lines) and the § Cross-Field block (`validations: [` with no import) fail with `TS2304: Cannot find name 'P'`, because they are fragments, so they stay unmarked.

### 2. `requires:` table names `mailbox` and `package-registry`

Code sites: `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` L58 `package-registry`, L64 `mailbox`; provider rows L216, L218) and `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` (`packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` L174 `package-registry` → `@objectstack/service-package` / `PackageServicePlugin`, L186 `mailbox` → `@objectstack/service-mailbox` / `MailboxServicePlugin`).

```diff
-| `marketplace` | `@objectstack/service-package` |
+| `mailbox` | `@objectstack/service-mailbox` — inbound mail |
+| `marketplace` `package-registry` | `@objectstack/service-package` |
```

`package-registry` shares the `marketplace` row because both keys resolve to the same package and plugin today (the comment at `capability-providers.ts` L164–L173). No count in prose (#27522).

### 3. `os generate <kind>` drops the retired `agent`

Code site: `RETIRED_GENERATORS` in `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` (L974, `agent` at L980: "agents are platform-internal (ADR-0063 §2)"; its refusal points at `os g skill`).

```diff
-| `os generate <kind>` | Scaffold an object / view / flow / agent from a template |
+| `os generate <kind>` | Scaffold an object / view / flow / skill from a template |
```

### 4. Hooks are taught as `body`

Code sites: `HookSchema.handler` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` L485: "DEPRECATED, prefer `body`") and `HookSchema.body` (L487–L498: preferred; when both are present the runtime uses `body`). The body's capabilities are `HookBodyCapability` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts` L48–L54); there is no `http.fetch` (L38: "outbound calls go through Connector recipes"). The `ctx.api.object(name).findOne({ where })` shape is the one the body runner exposes (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` L1119, gated as a READ by `api.read` in `quickjs-runner.ts` L705).

- `references/examples-objects.md` § Lifecycle Hooks: the example is a `body` (`language: 'js'`, `source` = the function body). The prose after it says `body` is the metadata-native form and names the inline `handler` only as deprecated.
- `rules/validation.md` § External / Custom Validation: the seat ruled option A. The example is a `body` that reads `blocked_tax_id` through `ctx.api` with `capabilities: ['api.read']` and throws. The lead now says "hitting another object or running arbitrary code", and adds that a `body` has no outbound HTTP, so an external-API check goes through a Connector recipe (home: `references/data-hooks.md` § Capabilities, L447).
- `SKILL.md` L46 index: "the sandboxed `body` (ctx + capability contract; the inline `handler` is deprecated)".

## Token readings (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0)

| File | `main` | This branch | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 6011 | 6007 | 6011 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6071 | 6077 | 6078 (+6 inside existing headroom, no deletion owed) |
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md` | 1728 | 1710 | 1728 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md` | 2746 | 2748 | 2756 |
| `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` | 3285 | 3285 | 3287 |

No ceiling is raised, so the ruling path was not used. No line was re-wrapped. Every deletion, with the facts it held and where each survives:

- **`objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § The Template:** "The memory driver and the Hono server are NOT in the file — the CLI auto-registers both at boot". Facts: no driver and no server in the scaffolded config; the CLI registers both. Homes, same file: § Wiring a driver — you usually do not ("Under `os dev` / `os serve` / `os start` the CLI resolves the driver itself … Do not put a driver in your config's `plugins:` array") and § Runtime Boot Sequence step 4 (`DriverPlugin`, `HonoServerPlugin` auto-registered). The line before it loses its trailing "The".
- **`objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md`:** the `ctx.input.created_at = new Date().toISOString();` line. It wrote a column the platform stamps on insert itself (objectql's audit hook, `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` L1975), so it taught a redundant write. The old prose's facts (inline in-process `handler`; preferred `body` of `language` / `source` / `capabilities`; isolated VM; the shape AI/Studio hooks and build artifacts carry) all remain in the new prose or the example.
- **`objectstack-data/rules/validation.md`:**
  - "Comprehensive guide for implementing validation rules in ObjectStack." Home: the H1 and the table of contents.
  - The `No async / custom type` bullet's tail ("external checks and arbitrary validation code belong in a `beforeInsert` / `beforeUpdate` lifecycle hook (see data-hooks.md)"). It now links § External / Custom Validation, which holds the hook rule and the `data-hooks.md` link. The "external checks" part also contradicted ruling A.
  - Common Script Patterns `// Conditional required field` (`record.type == 'enterprise' && isBlank(record.account_manager)`). Homes: the same block's "Require field when another field has value" pattern, and § Conditional Validation's `enterprise_requires_manager`, the same predicate.
  - "Lower numbers execute **first**." Home: the Priority block's comments "(run first)" / "(run last)".
  - Incorrect vs Correct "Script Logic Inverted" / "Correct — Script Logic". Homes: "⚠️ CRITICAL: … validation **fails** when it evaluates to `true`" (§ Expression Syntax) and `// ❌ Fails when this is TRUE` in § Script Validation; the correct amount check is the "Prevent negative values" pattern. The pair also held two unguarded `amount` comparisons. The "Validation Fires Too Often" pair stays, so § Incorrect vs Correct and its contents link remain.

## Eval cases

- `objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 3 (corrected): `must_contain` gains `!= null`; its `expected_output` already asked for explicit guards. (Site 1.)
- `objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 10 (new): block an `account` whose `tax_id` is in `blocked_tax_id`, and ask whether the hook can call a tax-authority API. Must contain `beforeInsert`, `beforeUpdate`, `language: 'js'`, `'api.read'`, `ctx.api.object(`; must not contain `handler:`, `HookContext`, `'http.fetch'`. (Site 4.)
- `objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` case 18 (new): inbound mail into mailboxes. Must contain `requires`, `'mailbox'`, `@objectstack/service-mailbox`; must not contain `MailboxServicePlugin(`. (Site 2.)
- `objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` case 19 (new): scaffold an object, a flow and an AI agent with the CLI. Must contain `os generate object`, `os generate flow`, `os generate skill`; must not contain `defineAgent(`. (Site 3.)

## Deviations (all three accepted by the seat before writing)

- **Generator roster.** The card's "live roster" (`object fields view list action flow dashboard app skill picklist`) is wrong: `fields` and `list` are keys inside templates. `GENERATORS` in `generate.ts` keys `object view action flow dashboard app skill picklist permission dataset`. The fix is unchanged (drop `agent`); `skill` takes its place, since that is what the refusal points at.
- **`os:check`.** Only the two blocks the gate accepts are marked, as § 1 says. The card's acceptance asked for all three validation examples.
- **Site 4 in `validation.md`** follows the seat's ruling A (a `body` cannot call an external API), not a literal port of the `handler` example.

## Other sites found (not changed: outside this card's file surface)

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` L219: hook ``condition: P`record.annual_revenue > 1000000` `` is an unguarded nullable operand. A hook `condition` is a covered surface (`validate-null-guards.ts` wiring table).
- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`: teaches the inline `handler` form first: 3 sites above § Sandboxed Hook Bodies (L309: L97, L161, L170) and 4 below (L739, L817, L845, L890), plus the comparison table at L319, so the reference itself still teaches the deprecated door first.
- `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` L268: ``P`record.amount > 10000 && …` `` is an unguarded comparison in an `os:check` block. It has no object, so it is not refused by itself, but it is the shape that gets copied.
